headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 7, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 16.14%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which returned 10.53%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolio is effectively navigating current market conditions, showcasing resilience during potential periods of macro uncertainty. The average alpha of 5.61% further emphasizes that the portfolios are not only gaining in value but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', stands out with a remarkable return of 44.86%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', returned 8.70%, still above the benchmark but less impactful compared to the leaders. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
